baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence magnifies God's hurumat, calls that good for the person, and locates the good near the person's Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: Magnification is not mere admiration: it increases the operative weight of a protected right so that it governs conduct. The resulting good is relational and formative because it is assessed in the near presence of the Lord who cultivates and completes.

activation_trace.role: Honor and inviolability make magnification the act of granting protected things operative weight.
Protected right, pledge, and dignity supply what must not be squandered or breached.
Nearness and presence turn the promised good into value assessed before the Lord.
Cultivation and completion make that assessment formative rather than merely locative.

changed_reading.before: Respecting divine prohibitions earns a benefit.
changed_reading.after: The person actively enlarges the governing force of protected divine rights, and that boundary-work becomes formative good in the Lord's presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Livestock are made lawful, except for what is recited to the audience.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lawfulness loosens a restriction, but the following recitation retains an attached exception. Permission therefore operates as a bounded release whose limit remains audibly renewable rather than as an unqualified transfer of control.

activation_trace.role: Dissolution of a ban supplies the legal opening rather than unrestricted ownership.
The livestock branch fixes the concrete resource over which release is granted.
Following in sequence makes the recited exception remain attached to and delimit the permission.

changed_reading.before: Livestock are generally permitted, with a previously known list of exceptions.
changed_reading.after: A prohibition is untied only within a continuing recited sequence, so permission remains bounded by speech that follows and delimits it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same repeated command to keep aside governs both the contaminant from idols and bent speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated side-distancing joins a material cult object and a verbal production into one decontamination protocol. Idols can stain and confuse by fixing worship onto an object; speech can depart from its line and be pre-shaped into falsehood. Both channels must be moved outside operative adjacency.

activation_trace.role: Active distancing and removal to the side supply one spatial operation for both prohibitions.
Staining, mixing contamination gives the cult object a transmissible effect rather than making it inert.
The worshipped image supplies the material channel onto which devotion is wrongly fixed.
Speech brought into audible expression supplies the second, socially mobile channel.
Deviation from a straight line makes false speech a directional distortion.
Pre-shaping and beautifying discourse shows how verbal distortion can be deliberately manufactured.

changed_reading.before: Avoid idols and avoid lying as two adjacent prohibitions.
changed_reading.after: Create the same operative distance from two contaminating media: fixed cult objects and manufactured, direction-bending speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacred precinct is made equal for the settled devotee and the outsider, while deviation within it is threatened. This turns a protected boundary from an exclusionary enclosure into a right of non-skewed access whose sanctity is violated by monopolization or diversion.

activation_trace.role: Protected right and inviolable claim anchor the revision in the focus plural hurumat.
Equality between two parties makes access, not exclusion, the sacred spatial norm.
Deviation from the straight or rightful line supplies the mechanism by which access is skewed.

structural_cues: 22:25 places the sacred mosque, equality of resident and outsider, and threatened deviation in one construction.
The focus follows this access warning within the same ritual sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access and punishable deviation at one sacred site; I extend that access logic to the focus plural hurumat. A live alternative is that 22:25 regulates only the mosque and does not generalize every inviolability.

changed_reading.before: Magnifying sacred limits means personally refraining from crossing them.
changed_reading.after: Magnifying sacred limits also means preserving their protected, non-exclusionary access structure and resisting uses that bend it toward private control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The livestock are first received as apportioned provision, then move through two distinct acts: eating and causing another to eat, with the poor named as recipient. Lawful release thus opens a circulation path rather than ending in private consumption.

activation_trace.role: Removal of restriction anchors the contextual change in the focus grant of lawfulness.
Livestock wealth is the resource whose lawful movement is being traced.
Apportioned gift makes the animals received provision rather than self-originating property.
Personal eating supplies the first permitted destination of the resource.
Feeding another turns permission outward into an enacted transfer.
Material need identifies the transfer's socially exposed recipient.

structural_cues: 22:28 names provision, the same livestock class, eating, feeding, and the poor in one ordered sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a provision-to-eating-to-feeding sequence; I read that sequence as the social direction of the focus permission. A live alternative is that feeding is a neighboring rite rather than an intrinsic condition of lawfulness.

changed_reading.before: The livestock clause grants a bounded permission to consume.
changed_reading.after: The bounded permission initiates a distributive circuit: received provision becomes lawful eating and obligatory attention to another's hunger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Magnifying ritual signs is located in the protected core of the heart, and the sacrificial materials are explicitly denied arrival while taqwa does arrive. Magnification therefore routes material practice into inward protective orientation and guided recognition, not material transfer to God.

activation_trace.role: Honor and inviolability anchor the contextual account of what magnification does.
Placing oneself in protection makes taqwa an active inward boundary.
The core or kernel locates ritual magnification in the person's interior center.
Contrasted arrival distinguishes what can reach the divine relation from what cannot.
Literal flesh supplies one material that is denied relational arrival.
Literal blood supplies the other material that is denied relational arrival.
Enlarging something in the chest turns magnification into an inward response to guidance.

structural_cues: 22:32 repeats magnification and explicitly derives it from heart-taqwa.
22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with taqwa, then commands magnification because of guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated magnification, heart-taqwa, failed material arrival, and guided magnification; I treat these as the mechanism behind the focus promise of good near the Lord. A live alternative is that signs and hurumat retain distinct scopes despite the repeated verb.

changed_reading.before: Large outward respect for sacred things wins divine approval.
changed_reading.after: Outward rite matters by forming an inward protective orientation that reaches the divine relation; its flesh, blood, and display do not themselves cross that distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate association simile converts failed exclusive orientation into a sequence of uncontrolled motion: fall, seizure, wind-driven descent, and remote deposition. Side-distancing in the focus now functions as preventive trajectory control, keeping material and verbal deviations from taking over the person's direction.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate distancing supplies the preventive action that preserves direction.
Directional bending anchors the model in the focus prohibition of false speech.
Association supplies the initial loss of exclusive orientation.
Noisy, unstable falling converts deviation into loss of self-directed motion.
Swift seizure shows an outside force capturing the fallen person's path.
Descent into an abyss supplies the vertical vector of disorientation.
Extreme remoteness supplies the endpoint produced when direction is surrendered.

structural_cues: 22:31 immediately follows the paired avoidance commands with a kinetic simile for association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fall sequence for association; I let it explain why active side-distance is needed and extend the directional risk to the paired bent-speech command. A live alternative is that the simile activates idols alone and says nothing about false speech.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance means refusing two forbidden items.
changed_reading.after: Avoidance is active control of adjacency and direction before a cult object or bent utterance captures the person's trajectory and deposits it far from its center.

context_deltas.mechanism: People are expelled for one truthful utterance, while reciprocal defense prevents demolition of multiple places where God's name is voiced. The negative command against bent speech thus acquires a positive public complement: truthful naming and the spaces that sustain it require protection.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance anchors the change in the focus command concerning speech.
Departure from the truthful line identifies the negative speech form to be excluded.
A voiced confession supplies the truthful speech whose social cost exposes the positive stakes.
Pushing harm aside turns protection from a private attitude into public counterforce.
Building collapse supplies the material consequence that defense prevents.
Mention flowing on the tongue connects protected buildings to sustained truthful naming.

structural_cues: 22:40 makes a truthful statement the sole stated cause of expulsion.
The same ayah links defense to the survival of several kinds of worship place where God's name is mentioned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persecuted truthful speech and defended naming-spaces; I infer that avoiding false speech has a constructive public counterpart in protecting truthful utterance. A live alternative is that the focus command remains individual while 22:40 concerns only communal defense.

changed_reading.before: Avoid false speech by keeping one's own words accurate.
changed_reading.after: Speech integrity also has public infrastructure: bent utterance is excluded while truthful naming and the diverse spaces that carry it are actively defended.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later transmission scene contains recitation, hostile casting into it, removal of the insertion, and firm establishment of signs. The focus exception by what is recited, beside the command to avoid manufactured speech, therefore reads as an integrity-sensitive channel rather than self-authenticating sound.

activation_trace.role: Following recitation anchors the model in the channel that delimits lawful livestock.
Deliberate pre-shaping of discourse supplies the focus warning against manufactured verbal content.
Recitation read and placed in sequence supplies the transmission surface under pressure.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive action against the transmission surface.
Removal followed by replacement supplies a corrective stage rather than passive reception.
Firm establishment and exactness supply the authenticated endpoint of the correction.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders recitation, hostile casting, removal, and establishment in one transmission sequence.
The focus places recited legal limitation and avoidance of manufactured speech in the same ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an insertion-and-correction process in prophetic transmission; I use it to make the focus recited exception integrity-sensitive. A live alternative is that 22:52 addresses a distinct prophetic event and should not qualify the dietary recitation in 22:30.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is recited functions as a transparent list of dietary exceptions.
changed_reading.after: Recitation is an authoritative but guarded transmission channel: what binds must survive the distinction between following revelation and cast, manufactured speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-primary fixedness branch of the idol noun and then reverses it through a late parable. It remains anchored in the focus word for idols, while 22:73 explicitly tests invoked beings' capacity and finds them unable to create or recover even a fly. Render it as an exploratory lexical reversal, not as a replacement definition of idol.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus calls for distance from the contaminant arising from idols; the idol root also carries an image of strength and fixed endurance.

activation_trace.role: Apparent strength and fixed endurance supply the idol's claim to stable agency.
Creative origination supplies the first agency test that the invoked beings fail.
The literal fly supplies the minimal creature that exposes the pretended strength.
Failed extraction from another's grasp supplies the second agency test.
Explicit lack of strength overturns the idol's branch image of fixed power.

changed_reading.after: Idols are also claims of durable agency whose fixed facade is experimentally collapsed by inability to originate or retrieve even the smallest life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a literal animal side reactivates a command normally read as an idiom for avoidance. It remains valid as a same-root spatial activation inside the livestock ritual sequence. Render it only as embodied choreography and adjacency management, never as a claim that the avoidance verb literally means an animal flank.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated focus verb creates side-distance from both cult contamination and false speech.

activation_trace.role: Moving something away to the side supplies the focus's repeated distancing action.
Alignment on a level row supplies deliberate bodily positioning before the sacrifice.
Falling supplies the transition that makes the animals' sides operationally salient.
The literal bodily flank re-materializes the spatial image carried by the focus avoidance commands.

changed_reading.before: Avoidance is an abstract rejection of wrong objects and words.
changed_reading.after: Avoidance carries an embodied spatial resonance: in a ritual field organized by rows, falling bodies, and exposed flanks, contamination and bent speech are deliberately kept beyond one's operative side.

strongest_changes: Hurumat became protected access and rights, not merely privately observed taboos.
Livestock lawfulness became a circulation from apportioned provision through eating to feeding the poor.
Magnification became heart-level protective orientation because flesh and blood do not themselves reach the divine relation.
False speech and recited exception became a broader integrity architecture joining truthful public naming with guarded transmission.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one ayah operate simultaneously as legal topology, resource circulation, ritual interiorization, trajectory control, and speech infrastructure without dissolving those readings into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The equal-access mechanism may belong specifically to the sacred mosque rather than every item in the plural hurumat.
The recitation-under-insertion scene may be too remote or domain-distinct to qualify the dietary recitation directly.
The falling simile explicitly targets association; its extension to the paired false-speech command remains inferential.
The fixed-idol and animal-flank outliers are lexical resonances, not claims of primary word meaning.
